They have 7 different color settings (the candlelight is my favorite) and a dimmer. They can get brighter than a normal light or as soft as a nightlight. The timer settings based on the sunrise/sunset is also a plus! Best lights I’ve ever gotten!! Will be buying more.

reviews.title: Great product with room to grow
reviews.text: The oasis lighting system is great for creating wonderful mood and atmosphere. The control app is effective and relatively simple, but lacks some features I think would be great. Notably, you cannot label and control individual lights that are set up in one room. This means you cannot program some lights to turn off or on in a light cycle without impacting all of the lights in the set room. You can get around this using some ad hoc set up, but I think more granular controls would go far!

reviews.title: Feature Request
reviews.text: App is nice but there should be a way to decouple the scheduled tone behavior from the scheduled on/off behavior.  I don’t want any lights to come on automatically, but I want the color tone to vary with the time of day when I turn on my lights manually.  When I turn on manually in the morning, tone can be cold automatically.  When I turn on manually in the evening, tone should automatically be warm. This would be a useful feature.

reviews.text: DO NOT BUY. Terrible product requiring a terrible app that is tracking your data and will sell it to 3rd parties for sure. First of all, the price tag is very expensive for a product that doesn’t work. Secondly, it requires you to set up a separate WiFi with 2.4 GHz. Secondly, If you can manage to do that, then cross your fingers and toes and PRAY that the lights will feel like connecting to your WiFi. They most likely will NOT connect, and now you have expensive night lights. Thirdly, the customer support is an Ai agent that is no help. These lights are great. I have two pucks and four bulbs for our living room.  They're connected via Google Home, which makes voice commands incredibly easy (even to percentages).

One future hope is setting up scenes that don't require a time or sunset/sunrise. Just, one that's called 'movie' or 'dinner' that we could use at any time.  There are some looks I'd love to save, but currently, it has to be tied to an automation.

That said, it's just a future hope. These are great lights and they're the sole lighting source for our living room and dining room space.

reviews.title: Absolutely love the lighting/experience
reviews.text: At first we were having a bit of trouble connecting them to the app until we discovered it was a setting on our router(SON) that was preventing them from connecting. After this the installation experience was a beautiful experience, all lights connected right away and the app interface is perfect. You are able to schedule each light and assign different names or room for each of them which I love! Customer support team was very helpful and fast responding to the issues I was experiencing and were able to help me out right away. I would 100%!! Recommend this lights/experience to all my friends and family. Will be buying more in the future.
